RENAL TRANSPLANT ULTRASOUND: Grayscale appearance of the

Doppler evaluation of the transplant kidney is similar to the

Brief Hospital Course:
A/P: ___ M with DM2, HTN, and ESRD s/p LRKT in ___ here today 
with renal failure, increased lower extremity edema, fevers, 
diarrhea and fatigue.
.
#. Acute on chronic renal failure:  Pt has known diabetic 
nephropathy in the past necessitating a renal transplant and 
unclear compliance with medical direction documented in multiple 
OMR notes.  His valsartan was held and his atenolol was changed 
to metoprolol.  Transplant renal u/s showed no evidence of 
obstruction.  BK virus PCR was undetectable.  The renal failure 
was felt to be slow progression of disease, so a biopsy was not 
performed.  Patient's creatinine improved with hydration/PRBC 
transfusions (2 units).  He was continued on his home Cellcept 
and prednisone dosing and his Prograf was decreased to 4 mg BID 
for consistently high troughs.  He was also started on 
calcitriol given the high PTH level.
.
#. Fever:  Pt has a history of FUO.  UA was negative; urine 
culture grew presumptive GARDNERELLA VAGINALIS.  Blood cultures 
were negative.  Pt already has a outpatient Rheumatology 
appointment arranged by his PCP for ankle pain, ?gout.  He was 
treated with acetaminophen prn.
.
#. Hypertension:  Due to his renal failure, his valsartan was 
discontinued and atenolol was changed to metoprolol.  He was 
continued on his nefidipine.  With the changes, there was some 
difficulty controlling his blood pressure.  His medications were 
titrated up to Metoprolol XL 300 mg and Nifedipine CR 90 mg.  Pt 
was also started on Lasix 40 mg daily. 
.
#. Diabetes:  Pt was continued on his home regimen of NPH and 
Humalog sliding scale.
.
#. Nausea:  Etiology is unclear but may be ___ renal failure or 
medication side effect.  He was treated with antiemetic prn.
.
#. Diarrhea:  This improved with imodium.  He was hydrated with 
IVFs.
.
#. Microcytic Anemia:  Pt was transfused 2 units of PRBCs.  Iron 
studies c/w anemia of chronic/renal disease and patient was 
started on Epo.  Vitamin B12, folate, and TSH levels were WNL.
